description:
Manage your passwords & passkeys Password and passkey manager that is compatible with ZX2C4's Pass commandline application: Credentials are stored in text files which are encrypted with OpenPGP. Features:
• Clone from and sync with a remote Pass Git repository
• View, add, and edit password entries.
• Supports time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) for two-step authentication
• Automatically fill and save credentials in apps and supported browsers
• Respond to passkey creation and authentication requests from browsers and native apps
